candidates.title: Introducing usage-based pricing for Amazon SageMaker AI bidirectional streaming
candidates.summary: AWS Marketplace now supports usage-based metering for Amazon SageMaker bidirectional streaming inference, so model providers can charge for what customers actually consume during a live stream. Deepgram is the launch partner, bringing usage-based speech-to-text and text-to-speech billing to AWS Marketplace.

candidates.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro from Moonshot AI is now available on Amazon Bedrock. Learn how to get started through the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Responses, and Converse APIs, optimize inference with explicit prompt caching, and use the model as a coding assistant in OpenCode.

candidates.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
candidates.summary: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

candidates.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
candidates.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

candidates.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
candidates.summary: Gemini Intelligence is rolling out to more devices. See how expanded capabilities across these devices help you do more.

candidates.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
candidates.summary: More than 20,000 veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a free year of ChatGPT Plus. See how they use it to prepare for civilian careers.

candidates.title: JioStar’s chief architect on AI discovery at 500M-user scale
candidates.summary: JioStar’s Vijay Seshadri explains AI discovery at 500M-user scale. Read his lessons on evals, guardrails, and taking AI into production.

candidates.title: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
candidates.summary: A new online archive of Esther Mahlangu’s life and art is now on Google Arts & Culture.
